observations: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate are paired with Lauramidopropyl Betaine and Cocamidopropyl Betaine.
Polyquaternium-10 is the main conditioning/deposition polymer.
Tetrasodium EDTA and Sodium Citrate are present as chelator/buffer signals.
Citric Acid appears early but finished pH is unknown.
Fragrance allergens and Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil are listed.
Post-unblind score adjustment: volumeV2 [1,2] -> [1,1] because Polyquaternium-10 is an isolated polymer/body signal and v1.4 caps isolated polymer/protein V2 evidence at 1.

claims.textVerbatim: Schwerelose Feuchtigkeit / Feuchtigkeitsshampoo; mit Kokosnussextrakt; ohne Silikone, ohne Sulfat, vegan.

cleansingStrength.rationale: SCI, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate and two betaines support moderate cleansing with upper-moderate capacity, without a classical sulfate-led strong call.

supportingSignals.observation: SCI, Sarcosinate and Betaines create moderate-to-upper-moderate non-classical-sulfate cleansing.
supportingSignals.inference: SCI, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate and two betaines support moderate cleansing with upper-moderate capacity, without a classical sulfate-led strong call.

counterSignals.observation: Sulfate-free does not automatically mean low cleansing.
counterSignals.inference: Sulfate-free does not automatically mean low cleansing.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Polyquaternium-10 provides a substantive cationic polymer route; without silicone, rich lipid or protein system the level remains moderate.

supportingSignals.observation: Polyquaternium-10 is one substantive cationic polymer route.
supportingSignals.inference: Polyquaternium-10 provides a substantive cationic polymer route; without silicone, rich lipid or protein system the level remains moderate.

counterSignals.observation: PQ-10 alone does not create high conditioning.
counterSignals.inference: PQ-10 alone does not create high conditioning.

weightPotential.rationale: One substantive PQ-10 route meets the v1.4 moderate threshold, while the otherwise lightweight architecture prevents high.

supportingSignals.observation: One substantive cationic polymer route justifies moderate weight potential.
supportingSignals.inference: One substantive PQ-10 route meets the v1.4 moderate threshold, while the otherwise lightweight architecture prevents high.

counterSignals.observation: No silicone or substantive lipid route is present.
counterSignals.inference: No silicone or substantive lipid route is present.

focusPrimary.rationale: The revealed “schwerelose Feuchtigkeit” story is compatible with general light care, but moisture is not a focus enum and `gentle` would overstate a scalp/mildness claim.

supportingSignals.observation: Lightweight moisture/care does not map cleanly to a non-overreaching focus enum.
supportingSignals.inference: The revealed “schwerelose Feuchtigkeit” story is compatible with general light care, but moisture is not a focus enum and `gentle` would overstate a scalp/mildness claim.

counterSignals.observation: Sulfate-free and vegan are attribute claims, not focus values.
counterSignals.inference: Sulfate-free and vegan are attribute claims, not focus values.

focusSecondary.rationale: No distinct secondary manufacturer direction with an independent formula route is stronger than the broad lightweight-care story.

supportingSignals.observation: No separate focus direction is selected.
supportingSignals.inference: No distinct secondary manufacturer direction with an independent formula route is stronger than the broad lightweight-care story.

counterSignals.observation: Shine or repair are not separately claimed in the packet.
counterSignals.inference: Shine or repair are not separately claimed in the packet.

usageRole.rationale: No explicit frequent non-strong, reset, deep-cleansing or treatment trigger is present; regular remains the default.

supportingSignals.observation: Retailer pages describe ordinary shampoo use with conditioner suggested.
supportingSignals.inference: No explicit frequent non-strong, reset, deep-cleansing or treatment trigger is present; regular remains the default.

counterSignals.observation: Lightweight moisture is not a frequent-use trigger by itself.
counterSignals.inference: Lightweight moisture is not a frequent-use trigger by itself.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: The unblind source reveals hair-moisture positioning, not cosmetic dry/tight/itchy/sensitive-scalp targeting; this resolves unknown to not_targeted.

supportingSignals.observation: The claims target lightweight hair moisture, not sensitive/dry/itchy scalp comfort.
supportingSignals.inference: The unblind source reveals hair-moisture positioning, not cosmetic dry/tight/itchy/sensitive-scalp targeting; this resolves unknown to not_targeted.

counterSignals.observation: Fragrance/citrus exposure limits sensitive confidence, but fragrance is not the reason for not_targeted.
counterSignals.inference: Fragrance/citrus exposure limits sensitive confidence, but fragrance is not the reason for not_targeted.

dandruffSupport.rationale: The complete formula lacks Piroctone Olamine and Climbazole; citrus or light cleansing claims cannot upgrade dandruff support.

supportingSignals.observation: Piroctone Olamine and Climbazole are absent.
supportingSignals.inference: The complete formula lacks Piroctone Olamine and Climbazole; citrus or light cleansing claims cannot upgrade dandruff support.

counterSignals.observation: Tetrasodium EDTA/Sodium Citrate are not accepted anti-dandruff actives.
counterSignals.inference: Tetrasodium EDTA/Sodium Citrate are not accepted anti-dandruff actives.

gateDiagnostics.weightDepositionLoad: Die Beschwerung wird qualitativ aus v1.4-Route-Arten abgeleitet; INCI liefert keine exakten Einsatzmengen oder Wiederholungs-/Residue-Daten.
gateDiagnostics.weightPersistence: Persistenz bleibt mechanistisch begrenzt, weil keine wiederholten Shampoo-only Ablagerungsdaten im Quellenpaket vorliegen.
gateDiagnostics.weightResetCapacity: Reset-Kapazität wird nur aus Tensid-/Chelator-/Klärungsarchitektur abgeleitet; keine Fertigprodukt-Resetprüfung ist erfasst.
gateDiagnostics.r3FormulaSignalNote: Keine anerkannte echte Bond-Repair-Route wird aus INCI abgeleitet; Plex/Keratin/Protein-Sprache bleibt kosmetisch und temporär.

evidence.scopeNotes: Exact-market formula and unblinded product/source-packet claim audit only; no public shampoo-only finished-product performance endpoint is captured.

claimAudit.claim: Schwerelose Feuchtigkeit mit Kokosnussextrakt, ohne Silikone und ohne Sulfat
claimAudit.support: SCI/Sarcosinate/Betaines plus Polyquaternium-10 support a light-care shampoo without silicone, compatible with lightweight moisture as a broad care story.
claimAudit.limitation: Moisture is not a v1.4 focus enum; coconut juice is very late, and sulfate-free alone is not proof of mildness or scalp comfort.

medicalBoundary.rationale: Lightweight moisture/sulfate-free positioning is cosmetic hair-care positioning, not medical or scalp-treatment language.
